reason: Both alerts are alert-TP. Alert 1 (java/xss): User input ('param') flows to 'bar' via doSomething(), which is then written to the response writer. Truncation does not prevent format string exploits. At least one alert-TP drives case TP.

doSomething derives 'bar' from 'param' via substring, preserving user control
